author: NingMeng123
title: 017 R196 装备品质规则

activation.modern_skills_and_clumsiness: Pure-rule parameters exist; runtime must not pretend these unimplemented gameplay states are active.

rules.formula: default=min(materialMaximum,average); setQuality clamps values exceeding materialMaximum
rules.multi_material: If minimum material max quality is below average use minimum; otherwise use highest material max quality.

rules.skills: Only when skills enabled and applicable skill missing: cap minimum at poor.
rules.effective_stack: Additionally capped by material maximum through ye.setQuality.

rules.rule: totalXp<=0 or missing enabled skill returns minimum; otherwise descend material maximum through fine and return first candidate whose rounded XP cost <= totalXp; none affordable returns minimum.

rules.formula: Dq=D*2^max(q.ordinal-2,0), implemented as float multiplication by 2 for each tier above average

rules.actual_cost: 0 when no quality, quality<=average, or exempt; candidate cost otherwise
rules.server_responsibility: Compute from trusted recipe/state, validate and debit only once per successful output. Never accept old client-computed XP cost.

rules.right_click: advance one ordinal, wrap maximum to minimum
rules.invalidated_by_xp: clamp to legal range and stop previous manufacturing

rules.rule: After one successful output, positive actual quality XP cost sets crafting_proceed=false; reset ticks for every completion.
rules.modern_interaction: Preserve accepted ordinary-left-click single and Shift-left-click repeat; paid quality stops after one even if Shift requested.

rules.requirement: input quality <= player maximum quality computed with full difficulty
rules.other_requirements: same item, one each, both damaged, same quality, no enchantments, same dye if dyed

rules.status_note: Caller must separately implement and verify the repair recipe, amount and consumption.

rules.damaged_input: blocked by normal non-repair crafting restriction

rules.rule: For repair, quality must be within full manufacturing difficulty eligibility; anvil-specific costs remain separate.

Mob randomization lowers unenchanted average-or-higher wood/leather one quality tier before damage; selected skeleton constructors force poor; natural held low-quality heavily damaged equipment participates in extra drop suppression.
rules.status_note: Equipment origin/loot chain must be tracked independently from player crafting implementation.

rules.rule: Quality stored, synchronized, copied and compared; preserve through inventories, hoppers, furnace movement, relog and save reload.

modern_adaptation_boundaries: User-requested adaptation (2026-10-13): selection previews the full material-supported range regardless of XP; manufacture and repair retain source XP eligibility. XP loss stops a batch without downgrading the selected preview; regaining XP requires a new start action.
Automated crafter has no R196 counterpart: explicitly define operatorless quality/XP policy.
Modern-only item material and manufacture-difficulty mappings require separate evidence labels.
Full professions, clumsiness gameplay, anvil rules and mob equipment generation are not proven implemented by this pure rule dataset.
Use existing bytecode-verified ExperienceRules 5L^2+15L, not the misleading CFR preincrement expression.
